svg.title: Write a useful support note
svg.desc: Turn observations into a short handoff. Reported: app froze. Checked: app window. Not verified: cause of earlier freeze. Keep the five facts separate. Never claim a cause that you did not verify.
svg.text: Turn observations into a short handoff.

g.text: Reported: app froze. Checked: app window.
Found: window responds; file is in Downloads.
Not verified: cause of earlier freeze.
Next: ask user to reproduce; protect unsaved work.

svg.text: Keep the five facts separate. Never claim a cause that you did not verify.
